issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but no open bead implements it (the dependency kind set is still blocks/relates_to per the CLAUDE.md bead contract). Add `verifies` as a third dependency kind: extend the dependency model, `bead dep` CLI, schema/capability document, checkpoint serialization, and cycle validation to cover the new kind. Add an advisory doctor diagnostic — never a rejection at insert time, never an automatic mutation, matching R021's posture — that reports a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead, naming a bounded sample of offending edges and the remedy. Do not infer the relationship from issue titles under any circumstance; include a test asserting title text never influences the diagnostic. Document the declaration in help, schema output, and specs, and note its planned use as input to R023 why-explanations.
